domains.name: Quantum Mechanics & Wave-Particle Duality
domains.concept: The fundamental theory of nature at atomic scales where particles exist in superposition of states described by probability amplitudes, collapsing to definite values only upon measurement.

domains.obscure_insights: Quantum tunneling allows particles to pass through classically forbidden energy barriers — the basis of nuclear fusion in stars, scanning tunneling microscopes, and flash memory. Decoherence explains why macroscopic objects appear classical despite quantum substrates.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Qiskit, QuTiP, PySCF, VASP

domains.name: Thermodynamics & Statistical Mechanics
domains.concept: Laws governing heat, work, and energy transformations in macroscopic systems, grounded in statistical behavior of microscopic particles — bridging atomic-scale randomness to bulk material properties.
domains.mathematical_basis: dU = dQ - dW; S = k_B * ln(Omega); F = U - TS; Maxwell-Boltzmann: P(E) = (1/Z) * exp(-E / k_B * T).
domains.obscure_insights: Entropy is not disorder but a count of microstates. Maxwell's demon thought experiment led to Landauer's principle: erasing one bit of information dissipates at least k_B * T * ln(2) joules — connecting information theory to thermodynamics.
domains.open_source_frameworks: LAMMPS, OpenMM, GROMACS, HOOMD-blue

domains.name: Electromagnetism & Maxwell's Equations
domains.concept: Unified theory of electric and magnetic fields showing they are two aspects of a single electromagnetic force, with light emerging as self-propagating electromagnetic waves.
domains.mathematical_basis: div E = rho/epsilon_0; div B = 0; curl E = -dB/dt; curl B = mu_0*(J + epsilon_0 * dE/dt); c = 1/sqrt(mu_0 * epsilon_0).
domains.obscure_insights: Maxwell's equations predicted radio waves 20 years before Hertz detected them. The displacement current term (epsilon_0 * dE/dt) was Maxwell's key insight — added purely for mathematical consistency, it enabled the prediction of electromagnetic radiation.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Meep, OpenEMS, FEniCS, GetDP

domains.name: Quantum Field Theory & Standard Model

domains.mathematical_basis: L = -1/4 * F_mu_nu^2 + i*psi_bar * gamma^mu * D_mu * psi - m*psi_bar*psi + |D_mu phi|^2 - V(phi); SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1) gauge group.
domains.obscure_insights: Virtual particles in vacuum fluctuations produce measurable effects: the Casimir force between uncharged plates and the Lamb shift in hydrogen energy levels. The Higgs mechanism gives mass to W and Z bosons while photons remain massless.

domains.open_source_frameworks: CAMB, CLASS, Planck data release, Astropy

domains.name: Number Theory & Prime Mathematics
domains.concept: The study of integers and their properties, particularly prime numbers, which are the building blocks of all integers and underpin modern cryptography, coding theory, and pure mathematics.
domains.mathematical_basis: Fundamental theorem: every n > 1 has unique prime factorization. Riemann hypothesis: all non-trivial zeros of zeta(s) = sum(1/n^s) lie on Re(s) = 1/2. Prime number theorem: pi(x) ~ x/ln(x).
domains.obscure_insights: The Riemann Hypothesis, unproven since 1859, implies that primes are distributed as randomly as possible — its truth would validate millions of downstream mathematical results. Twin prime conjecture (infinitely many p where p and p+2 are both prime) remains unsolved despite Zhang's 2013 breakthrough bounding gaps.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SageMath, PARI/GP, GMP, Wolfram Mathematica

domains.name: Calculus & Real Analysis
domains.concept: The mathematics of continuous change — differential calculus studies instantaneous rates, integral calculus studies accumulation of quantities, and real analysis provides rigorous foundations for limits, continuity, and convergence.
domains.mathematical_basis: Fundamental theorem: int_a^b f'(x)dx = f(b) - f(a). Taylor series: f(x) = sum f^(n)(a)/n! * (x-a)^n. Epsilon-delta: lim_{x->a} f(x) = L iff for all eps>0, exists delta>0 such that |x-a|<delta implies |f(x)-L|<eps.
domains.obscure_insights: Cantor showed there are different sizes of infinity — the real numbers are uncountably infinite while the natural numbers are only countably infinite. Lebesgue integration extends Riemann integration to handle more pathological functions and is the foundation of modern probability theory.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SymPy, Mathematica, Maple, SageMath

domains.name: Linear Algebra & Matrix Theory
domains.concept: The mathematics of vector spaces, linear transformations, and systems of equations. Underpins computer graphics, machine learning, physics simulations, signal processing, and quantum mechanics.
domains.mathematical_basis: Ax = b; SVD: A = U*Sigma*V^T; eigendecomposition: Av = lambda*v; determinant encodes volume scaling; rank-nullity theorem: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n.
domains.obscure_insights: The singular value decomposition (SVD) reveals the intrinsic geometric action of any matrix as a rotation, scaling, then another rotation. PCA is just SVD applied to centered data. All of deep learning's weight matrices are linear transformations — neural nets stack non-linear activations between linear layers.
domains.open_source_frameworks: NumPy, LAPACK, BLAS, Eigen, SciPy

domains.name: Topology & Manifold Theory
domains.concept: The study of properties preserved under continuous deformations — a coffee mug is topologically identical to a donut. Manifold theory extends this to curved multi-dimensional spaces underlying physics and machine learning.
domains.mathematical_basis: Euler characteristic: V - E + F = 2 - 2g for genus-g surfaces. Fundamental group pi_1(X). Stokes theorem: integral over boundary = integral of derivative over interior.
domains.obscure_insights: The Poincaré conjecture (every simply connected closed 3-manifold is homeomorphic to a sphere), proved by Perelman in 2003 using Ricci flow, earned a $1M Millennium Prize he declined. Topological data analysis (TDA) uses persistent homology to find shape in high-dimensional data.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Gudhi, Ripser, Giotto-tda, SageMath

domains.name: Probability Theory & Measure Theory
domains.concept: Rigorous mathematical framework for quantifying uncertainty. Probability theory built on measure theory provides foundations for statistics, stochastic processes, information theory, and all of machine learning.
domains.mathematical_basis: Kolmogorov axioms: P(Omega)=1; P(A)>=0; P(A union B) = P(A)+P(B) for disjoint A,B. Bayes: P(A|B) = P(B|A)*P(A)/P(B). Central limit theorem: sum of i.i.d. variables converges to Gaussian.
domains.obscure_insights: The law of large numbers guarantees sample averages converge to true means — but convergence can be arbitrarily slow. The Borel-Cantelli lemma: if sum of P(A_n) is finite, almost surely only finitely many A_n occur — a sharp tool for proving tail events.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SciPy, Stan, PyMC, R, NumPy

domains.name: Information Theory & Entropy
domains.concept: Shannon's theory quantifying information, compression limits, and channel capacity. Entropy measures average surprise in a random variable; mutual information measures shared information between variables.
domains.mathematical_basis: H(X) = -sum P(x)*log2(P(x)); channel capacity C = max_{P(X)} I(X;Y); Huffman coding achieves H(X) bits per symbol; KL divergence: D_KL(P||Q) = sum P(x)*log(P(x)/Q(x)).
domains.obscure_insights: Shannon proved that reliable communication over a noisy channel is possible at any rate below channel capacity — but gave no practical code construction. It took 50 years to find capacity-achieving codes (turbo codes, LDPC, polar codes). KL divergence is not symmetric and cannot be a true metric.
domains.open_source_frameworks: dit, pyitlib, SciPy, MATLAB

domains.name: Quantum Computing & Quantum Algorithms
domains.concept: Computing paradigm using quantum superposition and entanglement to perform computations exponentially faster than classical computers for specific problems like factoring, search, and simulation.
domains.mathematical_basis: Qubit: |psi> = alpha|0> + beta|1>, |alpha|^2 + |beta|^2 = 1. Gates: Hadamard H = 1/sqrt(2)*[[1,1],[1,-1]]. Shor's algorithm: O((log N)^3) for factoring N-bit integer vs classical O(exp(N^1/3)).
domains.obscure_insights: Quantum supremacy does not mean quantum computers are universally faster — only for specific problem classes. Decoherence is the central engineering challenge: qubits must be isolated from environment yet controllable. Grover's algorithm gives quadratic speedup for unstructured search, proven to be optimal.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QuTiP, Amazon Braket

domains.name: Cryptography & Information Security
domains.concept: Science of securing information through mathematical transformations making it computationally infeasible to break without secret keys. Modern cryptography relies on number theory, algebra, and computational complexity.
domains.mathematical_basis: RSA: c = m^e mod n; AES: 128/256-bit block cipher with substitution-permutation network. ECDH: shared secret = a*(b*G) = b*(a*G) on elliptic curve. Hash: SHA-256 produces 256-bit digest.
domains.obscure_insights: Perfect secrecy (one-time pad) requires the key to be as long as the message and used only once. Quantum computers running Shor's algorithm would break RSA and ECC — motivating post-quantum cryptography (lattice-based, hash-based schemes) standardized by NIST in 2024.
domains.open_source_frameworks: OpenSSL, libsodium, PyCryptodome, Bouncy Castle

domains.name: Operating Systems & Kernel Architecture
domains.concept: Software layer managing hardware resources, process scheduling, memory management, and I/O. The kernel is the core that runs in privileged mode, mediating all hardware access from user applications.
domains.mathematical_basis: Scheduling: O(1) scheduler uses run-queue with time slices. Virtual memory: page table mapping virtual address V to physical P; TLB caches recent translations. Deadlock: circular wait among processes holding and requesting resources.
domains.obscure_insights: The Linux kernel uses a Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS) based on a red-black tree ordered by virtual runtime — O(log n) insert/delete. Buffer bloat in network stacks is caused by oversized kernel receive buffers delaying congestion signals. eBPF allows safe kernel programmability without kernel modules.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Linux kernel, FreeBSD, RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr), seL4

domains.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
domains.concept: Fundamental building blocks of efficient computation — data structures organize information for fast access and modification, while algorithms define step-by-step procedures for solving computational problems.
domains.mathematical_basis: Big-O complexity: O(1) hash lookup, O(log n) binary search, O(n log n) optimal sort, O(n^2) bubble sort. Recurrence: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) gives T(n) = O(n log n) by Master theorem.
domains.obscure_insights: Skip lists provide O(log n) average search with simpler implementation than balanced trees. Van Emde Boas trees achieve O(log log U) operations on integers in universe U. The union-find data structure with path compression and union by rank achieves nearly O(1) amortized per operation (inverse Ackermann function).
domains.open_source_frameworks: STL (C++), Java Collections, Python heapq/collections, CLRS textbook

domains.name: Computer Networks & Distributed Systems
domains.concept: Protocols and architectures enabling communication between computers. Distributed systems coordinate multiple independent nodes to appear as a unified system — the foundation of the internet, cloud computing, and blockchain.
domains.mathematical_basis: TCP throughput: W/RTT where W=window size. CAP theorem: distributed system can guarantee at most 2 of Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance. Paxos/Raft consensus: requires majority (n/2 + 1) agreement.
domains.obscure_insights: The CAP theorem forced architects to choose between strong consistency (banking) and high availability (social media). Lamport clocks provide partial ordering of events without synchronized clocks. QUIC protocol (HTTP/3) runs over UDP and bakes in TLS, reducing connection setup from 2-3 RTT to 0-1 RTT.
domains.open_source_frameworks: ZooKeeper, etcd, Kafka, gRPC, Envoy

domains.name: Database Systems & Query Optimization
domains.concept: Systems for persistent structured data storage, supporting ACID transactions, concurrent access, and efficient querying. Query optimizers use cost models and statistics to generate optimal execution plans.
domains.mathematical_basis: Relational algebra: select sigma, project pi, join bowtie, union. B-tree: O(log_B n) disk reads. Query cost = sum of I/O + CPU for each operator. Cardinality estimation using histograms and sampling.
domains.obscure_insights: Volcano/iterator model (open/next/close) is the dominant query execution paradigm — data is pulled lazily through operator trees. Columnar storage (Parquet, ORC) achieves 10x compression and vectorized SIMD processing vs row storage for OLAP. MVCC (multi-version concurrency control) allows reads without blocking writes.
domains.open_source_frameworks: PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, Apache Arrow, RocksDB

domains.name: Compiler Theory & Programming Languages
domains.concept: Compilers translate high-level source code to machine instructions through lexing, parsing, semantic analysis, optimization, and code generation. Programming language theory studies type systems, semantics, and expressiveness.
domains.mathematical_basis: Context-free grammar: G = (V, Sigma, R, S). LL(1)/LR(1) parsing. Lambda calculus: (lambda x . M) N = M[N/x]. Hindley-Milner type inference: O(n * alpha(n)) with union-find.
domains.obscure_insights: LLVM's SSA (Static Single Assignment) form makes dataflow analysis trivial — each variable is defined exactly once, enabling powerful optimizations like constant propagation and dead code elimination. The Curry-Howard correspondence maps propositions to types and proofs to programs — logic and computation are isomorphic.
domains.open_source_frameworks: LLVM, GCC, ANTLR, Clang, Cranelift

domains.name: Organic Chemistry & Chemical Bonding
domains.concept: Study of carbon-based compounds and their reactions. Carbon's tetravalence enables an almost unlimited variety of molecular structures. Chemical bonding arises from electron sharing (covalent) or transfer (ionic) driven by achieving stable electron configurations.
domains.mathematical_basis: Bond energy: E = hbar*omega for molecular vibration. Molecular orbital theory: psi_bonding = psi_A + psi_B; Huckel rule for aromaticity: 4n+2 pi electrons. pKa = -log(Ka) quantifies acid strength.
domains.obscure_insights: Chirality (mirror-image molecules) is biologically critical — thalidomide's R-enantiomer was therapeutic while S-enantiomer caused birth defects. Curly arrows in mechanism drawings represent electron pair movement — not atom movement. Resonance structures are mathematical constructs, not physical oscillations between structures.
domains.open_source_frameworks: RDKit, OpenBabel, Avogadro, GAUSSIAN, ORCA

domains.name: Biochemistry & Protein Structure
domains.concept: Chemical processes within living organisms. Proteins are the molecular machines of life — their 3D structure (determined by amino acid sequence) determines their function in catalysis, transport, signaling, and structural support.
domains.mathematical_basis: Ramachandran angles (phi, psi) define backbone conformation. Free energy of folding: delta_G = delta_H - T*delta_S. Hill equation: theta = [L]^n / (Kd^n + [L]^n) for cooperative binding.
domains.obscure_insights: Protein folding is solved by AlphaFold2 (2021) using attention-based neural networks on evolutionary co-variation patterns — a 50-year problem. Prions are misfolded proteins that catalyze misfolding of normal proteins — infectious agents with no nucleic acid. Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are functional without stable 3D structure.
domains.open_source_frameworks: AlphaFold2, Biopython, PyMOL, GROMACS, OpenMM

domains.name: Genetics & Molecular Biology
domains.concept: DNA encodes hereditary information in sequences of nucleotides. The central dogma: DNA -> RNA -> Protein. Genes are segments of DNA encoding functional molecules; mutations alter sequences causing phenotypic changes.
domains.mathematical_basis: Mutation rate: mu ~ 10^-9 per base pair per generation. Hardy-Weinberg: p^2 + 2pq + q^2 = 1 for allele frequencies. Shannon entropy of genetic code: H = log2(4) = 2 bits per nucleotide.
domains.obscure_insights: Only ~2% of the human genome encodes proteins; the remaining 98% was once called 'junk DNA' but encodes regulatory elements, non-coding RNAs, and structural elements. CRISPR-Cas9 exploits a bacterial immune system as a programmable gene editor — discovery by Doudna and Charpentier won the 2020 Nobel Prize.
domains.open_source_frameworks: BioPython, GATK, HISAT2, Bowtie2, Ensembl

domains.name: Evolutionary Biology & Natural Selection
domains.concept: Darwin's theory of evolution by natural selection: heritable variation, differential reproduction, and time produce adaptation of populations to their environments. Modern synthesis integrates Mendelian genetics with Darwinian evolution.
domains.mathematical_basis: Fisher's fundamental theorem: rate of increase in fitness = additive genetic variance in fitness. Wright's fixation probability: P(fix) = (1 - e^{-2s}) / (1 - e^{-4Ns}) for selective advantage s in population N.
domains.obscure_insights: Genetic drift (random allele frequency changes) is as powerful as selection in small populations. Horizontal gene transfer between bacteria bypasses vertical inheritance — bacteria can acquire antibiotic resistance genes from other species instantly. Convergent evolution repeatedly arrives at similar solutions (wings in birds, bats, insects).
domains.open_source_frameworks: BEAST2, MrBayes, IQ-TREE, PopLDdecay, Slim

domains.name: Neuroscience & Brain Function
domains.concept: Study of the nervous system — the brain processes sensory information, generates behavior, stores memories, and gives rise to consciousness. Neurons communicate via electrical impulses (action potentials) and chemical neurotransmitters.
domains.mathematical_basis: Hodgkin-Huxley model: C_m * dV/dt = -g_Na*m^3*h*(V-E_Na) - g_K*n^4*(V-E_K) - g_L*(V-E_L) + I. Hebbian learning: delta_w = alpha * x * y.
domains.obscure_insights: The human brain has ~86 billion neurons with ~100 trillion synapses, consuming 20W of power. Sleep is critical for glymphatic clearance of metabolic waste including amyloid-beta (Alzheimer's risk). The default mode network (DMN) is most active during rest and self-referential thought — a possible neural correlate of the 'wandering mind'.
domains.open_source_frameworks: NEURON, Brian2, OpenNeuro, FreeSurfer, FSL

domains.name: Medicine & Pharmacology
domains.concept: Science of diagnosing, treating, and preventing disease. Pharmacology studies drug interactions with biological systems — pharmacokinetics describes drug absorption/distribution/metabolism/excretion; pharmacodynamics describes drug effects on the body.
domains.mathematical_basis: Drug plasma concentration: C(t) = C0 * e^{-k*t}. Half-life: t_{1/2} = ln(2)/k. Hill equation for dose-response: E = Emax * C^n / (EC50^n + C^n). Number needed to treat (NNT) = 1 / (ARR).
domains.obscure_insights: Most drugs have off-target effects (polypharmacology) that can be beneficial (aspirin: analgesic + antiplatelet) or harmful (antihistamines causing drowsiness). The blood-brain barrier excludes ~98% of small molecules — a major challenge in CNS drug development. Personalized medicine uses genomics to predict individual drug metabolism (pharmacogenomics).
domains.open_source_frameworks: RDKit (drug discovery), OpenTargets, ChEMBL, PubChem, OMOP CDM

domains.name: Immunology & Vaccine Science
domains.concept: The immune system defends against pathogens through innate (rapid, non-specific) and adaptive (slow, antigen-specific) responses. Vaccines train adaptive immunity by presenting antigens without causing disease.
domains.mathematical_basis: SIR model: dS/dt = -beta*S*I; dI/dt = beta*S*I - gamma*I; dR/dt = gamma*I. Herd immunity threshold: 1 - 1/R0. Affinity maturation: B-cells with higher antigen affinity selected through germinal center reaction.
domains.obscure_insights: mRNA vaccines (COVID-19) represent a platform technology that can be designed in days once a pathogen genome is sequenced. The adaptive immune system can generate ~10^18 unique antibody sequences through V(D)J recombination and somatic hypermutation. Immune checkpoint inhibitors (anti-PD1, anti-CTLA4) release T-cell brakes to attack cancer.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Biopython, IgBlast, IMGT, OpenVaccine, Rosetta

domains.name: Philosophy of Mind & Consciousness
domains.concept: Inquiry into the nature of mind, mental states, and consciousness. The hard problem asks why physical brain processes give rise to subjective experience (qualia). Key positions: physicalism, dualism, functionalism, panpsychism.
domains.mathematical_basis: Integrated Information Theory: Phi = intrinsic causal power of system. Global Workspace Theory: broadcast signal to cortical modules. Predictive processing: brain as prediction machine minimizing free energy F = E_q[log q(phi) - log p(phi, x)].
domains.obscure_insights: The Chinese Room argument (Searle) claims syntactic symbol manipulation (computing) cannot produce semantic understanding — challenging strong AI. Philosophical zombies — beings physically identical to humans but with no inner experience — are conceivable, challenging identity theories. Attention and consciousness may be doubly dissociable in the brain.
domains.open_source_frameworks: OpenCog, PyIIT, Global Workspace Architecture (GWT)

domains.name: Philosophy of Science & Epistemology
domains.concept: Epistemology studies the nature, scope, and limits of knowledge. Philosophy of science examines what distinguishes science from non-science, how theories are confirmed/falsified, and whether scientific theories describe reality.
domains.mathematical_basis: Bayesian epistemology: P(H|E) = P(E|H)*P(H) / P(E). Popper's falsifiability criterion: a theory is scientific iff it makes predictions that could in principle be false. Kuhn's paradigm shifts as social-scientific processes.
domains.obscure_insights: Duhem-Quine thesis: no hypothesis is tested in isolation — any observation tests the entire web of background assumptions. Underdetermination: multiple incompatible theories can equally fit all available evidence. Gettier problems showed that justified true belief is insufficient for knowledge — a counterexample to 2500 years of epistemology.
domains.open_source_frameworks: PhilPapers, SEP (Stanford Encyclopedia), Zotero

domains.name: Ethics & Moral Philosophy
domains.concept: Systematic study of right action and moral value. Major frameworks: consequentialism (maximize welfare), deontology (follow duties/rights), virtue ethics (cultivate character), contractualism (principles people could reasonably agree to).
domains.mathematical_basis: Utility theory: U(x) = sum w_i * u_i(x). Rawlsian maximin: choose policy maximizing the minimum welfare. Game-theoretic ethics: iterated prisoner's dilemma shows cooperation emerges from reciprocity.
domains.obscure_insights: Arrow's impossibility theorem proves no voting system can simultaneously satisfy a minimal set of fairness criteria — there is no perfect democratic aggregation. Moral uncertainty (not knowing which ethical theory is correct) may require maximizing expected moral value across theories. Trolley problems reveal conflicts between deontological intuitions and consequentialist calculations.
domains.open_source_frameworks: AI Alignment Forum, Center for Human-Compatible AI, Moral Graphs

domains.name: Psychology & Cognitive Biases
domains.concept: Psychology studies human thought, behavior, and emotion. Cognitive biases are systematic errors in thinking arising from heuristics — mental shortcuts that work well in most cases but fail predictably in others.
domains.mathematical_basis: Signal detection theory: d' = z(hit rate) - z(false alarm rate). Psychophysics: Weber's law: delta_I / I = k (just noticeable difference proportional to stimulus intensity). Drift-diffusion model: accumulate noisy evidence until threshold.
domains.obscure_insights: Kahneman's System 1/System 2 framework: fast intuitive thinking (System 1) is prone to biases; slow deliberate thinking (System 2) can override but requires effort. Confirmation bias is so powerful that presenting people with counter-evidence often strengthens their original belief (backfire effect). The planning fallacy causes chronic underestimation of project completion time even when people know they've been wrong before.
domains.open_source_frameworks: PsychoPy, jsPsych, PsychToolbox, OpenSesame

domains.name: Economics & Game Theory
domains.concept: Economics studies how agents allocate scarce resources. Game theory analyzes strategic interactions where outcomes depend on choices of multiple players — foundational to economics, political science, evolutionary biology, and AI.
domains.mathematical_basis: Nash equilibrium: no player can improve payoff by unilaterally deviating. Utility maximization: max U(x) subject to P*x <= W. Expected utility: E[U] = sum P(s)*U(x(s)). Shapley value: phi_i = sum_{S} |S|!(n-|S|-1)!/n! * [v(S+i) - v(S)].
domains.obscure_insights: The prisoner's dilemma shows that individually rational choices produce collectively suboptimal outcomes — the basis of environmental problems, arms races, and market failures. Mechanism design (reverse game theory) engineers rules so self-interested agents produce desired social outcomes. The St. Petersburg paradox reveals that expected value alone cannot explain rational choice — requiring utility theory.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Gambit, NASHPY, Mesa (agent-based modeling), AnyLogic

domains.name: Behavioral Economics & Decision Theory
domains.concept: Integrates psychological insights into economic models. Humans violate standard rational choice theory systematically — prospect theory, loss aversion, and present bias better predict actual decisions under uncertainty.
domains.mathematical_basis: Prospect theory: V(x) = x^alpha if x>=0; -lambda*(-x)^alpha if x<0 with alpha~0.88, lambda~2.25. Hyperbolic discounting: U(t) = 1/(1+k*t) vs exponential 1/(1+r)^t. Anchoring: estimate = anchor + insufficient adjustment.
domains.obscure_insights: Loss aversion (losses feel ~2.25x worse than equivalent gains feel good) is so powerful that investors hold losing stocks too long and sell winners too early. Default effects are enormous — switching organ donation opt-in to opt-out increases donation rates from ~15% to ~95%. Nudges exploit predictable irrationality to improve welfare without restricting choice.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Python (statsmodels), R, JAGS, Stan, oTree

domains.name: History of Science & Technology
domains.concept: Traces the development of human knowledge and technological capability — from early astronomy and mathematics through the Scientific Revolution, Industrial Revolution, and digital age. Scientific progress is not linear but driven by paradigm shifts.
domains.mathematical_basis: Exponential technology growth: Moore's law (transistors double every ~2 years). Kurzweil's law of accelerating returns: technological progress follows double exponential curve. Scientometric analysis: citation networks, h-index.
domains.obscure_insights: The printing press (1440) democratized knowledge and enabled the Protestant Reformation and Scientific Revolution within 100 years. The transistor (1947) may be the most consequential invention in human history. Scientific revolutions follow Kuhn's pattern: normal science -> anomalies -> crisis -> revolution -> new paradigm.
domains.open_source_frameworks: JSTOR, Google Scholar, OpenAlex, Zotero

domains.name: Linguistics & Language Structure
domains.concept: Scientific study of language — phonology (sounds), morphology (word structure), syntax (sentence structure), semantics (meaning), and pragmatics (context-dependent interpretation). Chomsky's universal grammar proposes an innate language faculty.
domains.mathematical_basis: Context-free grammar generates natural language structure. Zipf's law: word frequency f(r) ~ 1/r. Shannon entropy of English: ~1.3 bits/character. Word2Vec: maximize P(context | word) = exp(v_c * v_w) / sum_j exp(v_j * v_w).
domains.obscure_insights: Sapir-Whorf hypothesis: language shapes thought — languages with many snow words (Inuit) may allow finer perceptual distinctions. All human languages share universal features (recursion, displacement, duality of patterning) despite surface diversity. Language acquisition happens in a critical period — children deprived of language input before puberty cannot fully acquire it later.
domains.open_source_frameworks: NLTK, spaCy, StanfordNLP, Universal Dependencies, WordNet

domains.name: Environmental Science & Climate Change
domains.concept: Study of Earth's systems and human impact. Anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions are warming the planet, causing sea level rise, ecosystem disruption, and extreme weather. Earth's climate is a coupled nonlinear dynamical system.
domains.mathematical_basis: Energy balance: S*(1-alpha)/4 = sigma*T_e^4. Radiative forcing: delta_F = 5.35 * ln(C/C0) for CO2. IPCC carbon budget for 1.5C: ~500 GtCO2 remaining. Arrhenius 1896: first quantitative CO2-temperature estimate.
domains.obscure_insights: Ocean heat content has increased so dramatically that if that heat entered the atmosphere, it would increase temperature by over 1000°C. Tipping points (Arctic ice albedo feedback, permafrost methane) can cause non-linear, irreversible transitions even if emissions stop. Earth's last time CO2 was at 420ppm was ~3 million years ago when sea levels were 15-25m higher.
domains.open_source_frameworks: CESM, OpenIFS, Copernicus Climate Data Store, CMIP6

domains.name: Ecology & Ecosystem Dynamics
domains.concept: Study of interactions between organisms and their environment. Ecosystems are networks of energy flow and nutrient cycling; species interact through predation, competition, mutualism, and parasitism forming complex food webs.
domains.mathematical_basis: Lotka-Volterra predator-prey: dx/dt = ax - bxy; dy/dt = cbxy - dy. Species-area relationship: S = c * A^z. Shannon diversity: H = -sum p_i * ln(p_i). Carrying capacity K in logistic growth: dN/dt = rN(1-N/K).
domains.obscure_insights: Keystone species have disproportionate ecosystem effects — removing wolves from Yellowstone changed river flow patterns through trophic cascade effects. Mycorrhizal fungal networks connect forest trees enabling nutrient sharing and chemical communication — the 'wood wide web'. Mass extinctions (5 so far) reset evolutionary trajectories; current rate is 100-1000x background rate.
domains.open_source_frameworks: R (vegan, ape), QIIME2, NetLogo, EcoSim

domains.name: Electrodynamics & Photonics
domains.concept: Classical and quantum electrodynamics describe interactions of light and matter. Photonics applies electromagnetic wave manipulation — lasers, fiber optics, LEDs, solar cells — forming the backbone of modern communications.
domains.mathematical_basis: Wave equation: d^2E/dt^2 = c^2 * nabla^2 E. Fresnel equations for reflection/transmission at interfaces. Laser gain: G = exp(gamma * L). Single-mode fiber: V = pi*d*NA/lambda < 2.405.
domains.obscure_insights: Optical fiber carries information as light pulses traveling slightly slower than c (refractive index ~1.5). Coherent optical communications using polarization-division multiplexing achieve >100 Tbps per fiber. Photonic integrated circuits (PICs) can integrate thousands of optical components on a chip using silicon photonics.
domains.open_source_frameworks: MEEP, Lumerical (commercial), gdspy, SimPhoNy

domains.name: Materials Science & Nanotechnology
domains.concept: Study of structure-property relationships in solids, liquids, and nanoscale materials. Nanotechnology manipulates matter at the atomic/molecular scale (1-100nm) where quantum effects dominate, enabling new material properties.
domains.mathematical_basis: Hooke's law: F = -k*x. Young's modulus: E = stress/strain. Band gap theory: E_g determines optical/electrical properties. Quantum confinement: E_n = hbar^2 * pi^2 * n^2 / (2m * L^2) for particle-in-a-box.
domains.obscure_insights: Graphene is 200x stronger than steel but just one atom thick. Carbon nanotubes can be metallic or semiconducting depending on chirality (rolling direction) — same atoms, different structure, radically different properties. Self-assembling nanomaterials exploit thermodynamic equilibrium to build structures without external control.
domains.open_source_frameworks: LAMMPS, VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, ASE, OpenMX

domains.name: Robotics & Control Theory
domains.concept: Robotics integrates mechanics, electronics, and computation to build machines that act in the physical world. Control theory provides mathematical frameworks for designing systems that achieve desired states despite uncertainty and disturbance.
domains.mathematical_basis: PID controller: u(t) = Kp*e(t) + Ki*int(e(t)dt) + Kd*de/dt. State-space: dx/dt = Ax + Bu; y = Cx + Du. Kalman filter: optimal state estimation with Gaussian noise. SLAM: simultaneous localization and mapping.
domains.obscure_insights: Boston Dynamics' robots use Model Predictive Control (MPC) computing thousands of future trajectories per second. The curse of dimensionality makes classical control intractable for high-DOF systems — motivating learning-based approaches. Lyapunov stability: a system is stable if a 'energy-like' function decreases over time.
domains.open_source_frameworks: ROS2, Drake, Gazebo, MoveIt, OpenRAVE

domains.name: Statistical Learning Theory
domains.concept: Mathematical theory analyzing generalization of learning algorithms — when and why machine learning works. PAC learning, VC dimension, Rademacher complexity, and bias-variance tradeoff provide rigorous bounds on learnability.
domains.mathematical_basis: PAC bound: P[error > eps] <= delta if m >= (1/eps)*(ln|H| + ln(1/delta)). VC dimension d: shattering 2^d points. Bias-variance: E[loss] = bias^2 + variance + irreducible noise. Generalization gap <= O(sqrt(d*log(m)/m)).
domains.obscure_insights: Neural networks violate classical learning theory — they are massively overparameterized yet generalize well. Double descent: as model capacity increases, test error first decreases, then increases (overfitting), then decreases again. Implicit regularization from SGD noise and gradient descent bias toward 'flat' minima is a major open research question.
domains.open_source_frameworks: scikit-learn, PyTorch, JAX, Keras

domains.name: Signal Processing & Fourier Analysis
domains.concept: Mathematical tools for analyzing and manipulating signals — audio, images, radio waves, vibrations. Fourier analysis decomposes any signal into constituent frequencies, enabling filtering, compression, and feature extraction.
domains.mathematical_basis: Fourier transform: F(omega) = int f(t)*e^{-i*omega*t} dt. Nyquist-Shannon: sample rate >= 2*f_max to reconstruct signal. FFT: O(n log n) DFT computation. Convolution theorem: multiplication in frequency = convolution in time.
domains.obscure_insights: JPEG compression uses Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) — a variant of Fourier that keeps energy in few coefficients. The FFT algorithm (Cooley-Tukey, 1965) is considered one of the most important algorithms of the 20th century. Wavelets are superior to Fourier for signals with localized features (edges in images).
domains.open_source_frameworks: NumPy/SciPy (fft), LibROSA (audio), PyWavelets, OpenCV

domains.name: Graph Theory & Network Science
domains.concept: Graph theory studies networks of nodes and edges. Network science applies this to real-world systems — social networks, the internet, biological networks, power grids. Small-world and scale-free properties emerge across domains.
domains.mathematical_basis: Adjacency matrix A; degree distribution P(k). PageRank: r = alpha*A*r + (1-alpha)*1/n. Clustering coefficient: C = (triangles) / (possible triangles). Watts-Strogatz small-world: short paths + high clustering.
domains.obscure_insights: Scale-free networks (power law degree distribution: P(k) ~ k^{-gamma}) emerge from preferential attachment — rich get richer. The internet, social networks, and protein interaction networks are all scale-free. Six degrees of separation: any two humans are connected by ~6 social links — empirically verified by Watts-Strogatz experiments.
domains.open_source_frameworks: NetworkX, igraph, Gephi, Neo4j, graph-tool

domains.name: Fluid Dynamics & Navier-Stokes Equations
domains.concept: Continuum mechanics of fluid flow — liquids, gases, and plasmas. The Navier-Stokes equations govern fluid motion; turbulence remains one of the greatest unsolved problems in classical physics.
domains.mathematical_basis: rho*(du/dt + u*nabla*u) = -nabla*p + mu*nabla^2*u + f. Reynolds number Re = rho*v*L/mu: laminar (Re<2000) vs turbulent (Re>4000). Kolmogorov energy cascade: E(k) ~ k^{-5/3}.
domains.obscure_insights: Proving global existence and smoothness of Navier-Stokes solutions is a Millennium Prize Problem worth $1M. Turbulence produces chaotic flow with energy cascades from large eddies to small ones where viscosity dissipates it as heat. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) uses discretized Navier-Stokes to simulate aircraft, weather, blood flow, and rocket engines.
domains.open_source_frameworks: OpenFOAM, FEniCS, SU2, Basilisk, OpenLB

domains.name: Chaos Theory & Nonlinear Dynamics
domains.concept: Study of deterministic systems whose behavior appears random due to extreme sensitivity to initial conditions. Small differences in starting state diverge exponentially — the butterfly effect. Strange attractors govern long-term behavior.
domains.mathematical_basis: Lyapunov exponent lambda: nearby trajectories diverge as e^{lambda*t}. Logistic map: x_{n+1} = r*x_n*(1-x_n) exhibits period-doubling route to chaos. Feigenbaum constant delta=4.669... is universal across chaotic systems.
domains.obscure_insights: Weather is chaotic with a predictability horizon of ~2 weeks regardless of model improvement. The Lorenz attractor (1963) demonstrated chaos in a 3D ODE system modeling atmospheric convection — a low-dimensional system producing infinite complexity. Chaotic systems can be controlled (OGY method) using tiny perturbations applied at the right moment.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SciPy, Nolds, ChaosPy, PyDSTool

domains.name: Nuclear Physics & Energy
domains.concept: Study of atomic nuclei and nuclear reactions. Fission splits heavy nuclei releasing energy (nuclear power plants, weapons). Fusion combines light nuclei (powers stars and tokamak reactors). Radioactive decay transforms unstable nuclei.
domains.mathematical_basis: Binding energy: E = delta_m * c^2 (mass defect). Radioactive decay: N(t) = N0 * e^{-lambda*t}; half-life t_{1/2} = ln2/lambda. Fusion cross-section peaks at ~100 keV for D-T reaction. Critical mass for chain reaction: k = eta*epsilon*p*f*l>1.
domains.obscure_insights: Nuclear power plants emit less radiation per unit energy than coal plants (coal contains naturally radioactive uranium and thorium). The Sun produces 3.8 x 10^26 W by fusing 620 million tons of hydrogen per second. ITER tokamak (France) aims to achieve Q>10 (10x more energy out than in) by 2035 — still 50 years away since 1980.
domains.open_source_frameworks: OpenMC, Serpent2, MCNP (DOE), ENDF nuclear data library

domains.name: Astronomy & Astrophysics
domains.concept: Study of celestial objects and processes. Stars form, fuse elements, and die as white dwarfs, neutron stars, or black holes. Galaxies — hundreds of billions of stars — cluster into filaments of large-scale structure.
domains.mathematical_basis: Luminosity-distance: F = L / (4*pi*d^2). Stefan-Boltzmann: L = 4*pi*R^2 * sigma * T^4. Schwarzschild radius: r_s = 2GM/c^2. Hubble law: v = H0 * d (H0 ~ 70 km/s/Mpc).
domains.obscure_insights: Black holes do not suck — an object at Earth's current orbit would orbit a solar-mass black hole identically to orbiting the Sun. Gravitational waves from black hole mergers (LIGO 2015) confirmed GR to 14 decimal places. Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) release more energy in milliseconds than the Sun emits in days — origin still uncertain.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Astropy, GALFIT, CASA, SAOImage DS9, OpenGW

domains.name: Political Science & Governance
domains.concept: Study of political systems, power, governance, and state behavior. Major systems: democracy, authoritarianism, federalism. International relations theories: realism (power), liberalism (cooperation), constructivism (norms).
domains.mathematical_basis: Arrow's theorem: no perfect voting system exists. Spatial voting model: voter utility U = -||position_voter - position_candidate||^2. Expected utility in deterrence: E[war] < E[peace] when status quo preferable.
domains.obscure_insights: Democracies almost never go to war with each other (democratic peace theory) — a rare near-empirical law in social science. Duverger's law: plurality voting systems (first-past-the-post) tend toward two-party systems; proportional representation produces multiparty systems. Veto players theory: more actors who can block change means more stable but less adaptable systems.
domains.open_source_frameworks: V-Dem dataset, Polity5, GDELT, Our World in Data

domains.name: Sociology & Social Networks
domains.concept: Study of human society, social structures, and collective behavior. Social networks shape information diffusion, norm enforcement, economic opportunity, and collective action. Institutions are the rules shaping social interaction.
domains.mathematical_basis: Structural holes (Burt): betweenness centrality = sum_{s!=v!=t} sigma(s,t|v)/sigma(s,t). Schelling segregation model: agents prefer >30% same-type neighbors produces complete segregation. Granovetter: weak ties carry more novel information than strong ties.
domains.obscure_insights: Dunbar's number (~150) is the cognitive limit on stable social relationships, arising from neocortex size constraints — groups exceeding this require institutional rules. Social contagion follows different dynamics than disease — complex contagion requires multiple exposures before adoption. Status hierarchies emerge spontaneously in groups and are remarkably stable and consequential.
domains.open_source_frameworks: NetworkX, Gephi, igraph, Stanford SNAP, Pajek

domains.name: Classical Mechanics & Hamiltonian Dynamics
domains.concept: Foundation of physics describing motion of macroscopic objects under forces. Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formulations reformulate Newton's laws using energy, generalizing to any coordinate system and providing the bridge to quantum mechanics.
domains.mathematical_basis: Lagrangian L = T - V; Euler-Lagrange: d/dt(dL/dq_dot) - dL/dq = 0. Hamiltonian H = sum p*q_dot - L = T + V. Hamilton's equations: dq/dt = dH/dp; dp/dt = -dH/dq. Noether's theorem: symmetry -> conservation law.
domains.obscure_insights: Noether's theorem is arguably the most beautiful theorem in physics: energy conservation comes from time-translation symmetry; momentum conservation from spatial-translation symmetry; angular momentum from rotational symmetry. Phase space volume is conserved (Liouville's theorem), which is why entropy cannot decrease in isolated systems.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SciPy (integrate), SymPy (mechanics), SimPy, Julia (DifferentialEquations.jl)

domains.name: Machine Learning Interpretability & Explainable AI
domains.concept: Methods for understanding how ML models make predictions — critical for trust, debugging, fairness auditing, and regulatory compliance. Ranges from model-agnostic post-hoc explanations to inherently interpretable models.
domains.mathematical_basis: SHAP: phi_i = sum_{S subset F\{i}} |S|!(|F|-|S|-1)!/|F|! * [f(S+i) - f(S)]. LIME: locally approximate f with interpretable g. Attention rollout: recursively multiply attention matrices across layers.
domains.obscure_insights: Attention weights are not faithfully interpretable — high attention does not imply high contribution to output. Gradient-based methods (Integrated Gradients) assign attribution by integrating gradients from a baseline. Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) probe for human-defined concepts inside neural network layers.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SHAP, LIME, Captum, TransformerLens, Ecco

domains.name: Optimization Theory & Convex Analysis
domains.concept: Mathematical study of finding minima or maxima of functions subject to constraints. Convex optimization problems have globally optimal solutions efficiently findable. Non-convex problems (like neural network training) are solved approximately with heuristics.
domains.mathematical_basis: KKT conditions: necessary for local minimum. Gradient descent: x_{t+1} = x_t - alpha*nabla_f(x_t). Duality: max g(lambda) <= min f(x). Convergence of GD: O(1/T) for convex, O(1/T^2) for strongly convex (Nesterov acceleration).
domains.obscure_insights: Neural network loss landscapes are high-dimensional non-convex surfaces with saddle points, not local minima, as the dominant obstruction. The loss landscape of overparameterized networks is well-connected — paths between solutions with low loss. ADAM optimizer maintains per-parameter learning rates — it adapts to gradient history, crucial for sparse gradients.
domains.open_source_frameworks: CVXPY, Optuna, scipy.optimize, JAX, Pyomo

domains.name: Differential Geometry & Tensor Calculus
domains.concept: Geometry of curved surfaces and smooth manifolds using calculus. Tensors are coordinate-independent geometric objects — the natural language of general relativity and modern deep learning (weight tensors, attention tensors).
domains.mathematical_basis: Covariant derivative: nabla_mu V^nu = d_mu V^nu + Gamma^nu_{mu sigma} V^sigma. Riemann tensor: R^rho_{sigma mu nu} = d_mu Gamma^rho_{nu sigma} - ... . Geodesic equation: d^2x^mu/ds^2 + Gamma^mu_{alpha beta} dx^alpha/ds * dx^beta/ds = 0.
domains.obscure_insights: Einsteins summation convention (implicit sum over repeated indices) reduces notation enormously but confuses newcomers for years. Parallel transport around a closed loop rotates vectors by an angle equal to the enclosed curvature — the Aharonov-Bohm effect in quantum mechanics is a topological version of this. Differential forms unify gradient, curl, divergence into a single exterior derivative operator.
domains.open_source_frameworks: GRTensorJ, SageManifolds, Cadabra2, EinsteinPy

domains.name: Human-Computer Interaction & UX Design
domains.concept: Study and design of interfaces between humans and computers. HCI combines psychology, design, and computer science to make technology usable, efficient, and satisfying. UX design centers user needs through iterative testing.
domains.mathematical_basis: Fitts' law: MT = a + b*log2(1 + D/W) for movement time to target of width W at distance D. Hick's law: RT = b*log2(n+1) for n choices. 7±2 chunks in working memory (Miller). Google's HEART metrics: Happiness, Engagement, Adoption, Retention, Task success.
domains.obscure_insights: Dark patterns are deceptive UX designs that trick users into unintended actions — widely used in e-commerce and subscription cancellation flows. The paradox of choice (Schwartz) shows that more options can decrease satisfaction and increase regret. Voice interfaces (like Jarvis) must handle Midas touch problem: distinguishing intentional from background speech.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Figma, Axure, Hotjar, Eye-tracking (Tobii), A/B testing frameworks

domains.name: Microeconomics & Market Design
domains.concept: Study of individual economic agents (consumers, firms) and market equilibria. Market design engineers economic institutions — auctions, matching markets, platform design — to achieve efficient and fair outcomes.
domains.mathematical_basis: Supply-demand equilibrium: P* where Q_s(P*) = Q_d(P*). Producer surplus = integral_{P*}^{max} supply curve. Vickrey auction: second-price sealed bid is dominant strategy truthful. Gale-Shapley algorithm for stable matching: O(n^2).
domains.obscure_insights: FCC spectrum auctions (designed by game theorists) have raised $200B+ for the US government. Uber's surge pricing is a real-time Walrasian auction matching drivers to riders. Platform two-sided markets (Uber, Airbnb, Google) face chicken-and-egg problems — must attract both sides simultaneously to create value.
domains.open_source_frameworks: CVXPY (auction design), Mesa (agent-based markets), QuantEcon

domains.name: Solid State Physics & Semiconductor Theory
domains.concept: Physics of crystalline solids — electronic band structure, semiconductors, superconductors, and magnetic materials. Semiconductor physics underlies all modern electronics — transistors, solar cells, LEDs.
domains.mathematical_basis: Bloch's theorem: psi_{n,k}(r) = e^{ik*r} * u_{n,k}(r). Density of states: g(E) = (1/2*pi^2) * (2m*/hbar^2)^{3/2} * sqrt(E). p-n junction built-in potential: V_bi = kT/q * ln(N_A*N_D/ni^2).
domains.obscure_insights: Silicon's bandgap of 1.12 eV makes it nearly ideal for solar cells (Shockley-Queisser limit ~33% efficiency). Topological insulators conduct electricity only on their surface due to protected edge states from topological invariants — immune to defects. High-temperature superconductors (cuprates) superconduct at 135K but their mechanism remains unexplained after 35 years.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP, Wannier90, VESTA

domains.name: Public Health & Epidemiology
domains.concept: Epidemiology studies disease distribution and determinants in populations. Public health implements interventions — vaccination, sanitation, policy — to improve population health. Evidence-based medicine applies statistical methods to clinical research.
domains.mathematical_basis: SIR model: R0 = beta/gamma determines epidemic potential. Odds ratio: OR = (a*d)/(b*c). Confidence interval: mean ± z_{alpha/2} * sigma/sqrt(n). Kaplan-Meier survival curves. Number needed to treat: NNT = 1/ARR.
domains.obscure_insights: John Snow's 1854 cholera map — identifying the Broad Street pump before germ theory — founded epidemiology. Bradford Hill criteria establish causation from correlation in epidemiology (strength, consistency, specificity, temporality, dose-response). Healthy user bias is a major confound in observational studies — people who take vitamins are also more health-conscious overall.
domains.open_source_frameworks: R (survival, epi), Python (lifelines, pyepid), OpenEHR, OMOP CDM

domains.name: Cognitive Science & Mental Models
domains.concept: Interdisciplinary study of mind spanning psychology, neuroscience, AI, linguistics, anthropology, and philosophy. Mental models are internal representations of external reality used for reasoning, planning, and decision-making.
domains.mathematical_basis: ACT-R cognitive architecture: RT = F * e^{-activation/T}. Bayes brain: perception = P(world | sensory data) = P(sensory data | world) * P(world). Schema theory: memory organized around prototypical structures.
domains.obscure_insights: Dual coding theory (Paivio): information encoded both verbally and visually is recalled better than either alone. The spacing effect: distributed practice produces stronger memory than massed practice — directly applicable to study techniques. Working memory capacity (4±1 chunks, not 7±2 as originally thought) is a fundamental bottleneck for learning.
domains.open_source_frameworks: ACT-R, PRIMs, CLARION cognitive architectures

domains.name: Formal Logic & Automated Reasoning
domains.concept: Propositional and predicate logic provide formal languages for rigorous reasoning. Automated theorem provers and model checkers verify mathematical proofs and software correctness mechanically.
domains.mathematical_basis: Propositional logic: tautologies, SAT problem (NP-complete). Predicate logic: forall x . P(x) => Q(x). Resolution rule: (A v B), (~A v C) |- (B v C). Godel completeness: every valid first-order sentence is provable. Incompleteness: no consistent system proves all true arithmetic statements.
domains.obscure_insights: Godel's incompleteness theorems (1931) shattered Hilbert's program to axiomatize all mathematics — any sufficiently powerful consistent system contains true but unprovable statements. SAT solvers (DPLL, CDCL) now routinely solve instances with millions of variables despite worst-case NP-completeness. The four-color theorem (1976) was the first major theorem proved with computer assistance.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Z3, Coq, Isabelle, Lean4, MiniSAT

domains.name: Finance & Quantitative Analysis
domains.concept: Financial mathematics models asset prices, risk, and portfolio optimization. Modern portfolio theory, options pricing (Black-Scholes), and risk management transformed finance from art to quantitative science.
domains.mathematical_basis: Black-Scholes: dS = mu*S*dt + sigma*S*dW. Option price: C = S*N(d1) - K*e^{-rT}*N(d2). Portfolio optimization: max mu^T*w - lambda*w^T*Sigma*w. VaR: loss exceeded with 1% probability. Sharpe ratio: (mu - rf)/sigma.
domains.obscure_insights: LTCM (Long-Term Capital Management) collapsed in 1998 despite being run by two Nobel laureates — tail risks were catastrophically underestimated. The Black-Scholes model assumes log-normal returns but real markets have fat tails and volatility clustering — Mandelbrot observed markets are fractal. High-frequency trading (HFT) firms earn edge from microsecond latency advantages.
domains.open_source_frameworks: QuantLib, Zipline, Backtrader, pandas, scipy.stats

domains.name: Architecture & Urban Planning
domains.concept: Architecture is the art and science of designing habitable space. Urban planning designs cities for livability, sustainability, and economic vitality. Both must balance aesthetics, function, structural integrity, and social impact.
domains.mathematical_basis: Structural load analysis: stress = F/A; moment M = F*L. Floor area ratio (FAR) governs density. Transit accessibility: distance-decay function. Christopher Alexander's pattern language: 253 design patterns for human-centered architecture.
domains.obscure_insights: Jane Jacobs (Death and Life of Great American Cities, 1961) showed that urban renewal projects destroyed the mixed-use density that created safe, vibrant neighborhoods. Induced demand proves that building more roads increases traffic — expanding highways is counterproductive for congestion. Passive house (Passivhaus) buildings reduce heating energy by 90% through airtightness and heat recovery.
domains.open_source_frameworks: OpenStreetMap, QGIS, FreeCAD, Rhino/Grasshopper

domains.name: Photosynthesis & Light-Dependent Reactions
domains.concept: Biological process converting solar photons into chemical energy (glucose and ATP) across thylakoid membranes in chloroplasts using Photosystems I and II.
domains.mathematical_basis: 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + photons -> C6H12O6 + 6 O2; delta_G0 = +2870 kJ/mol. Z-scheme electron transport driven by redox potentials.
domains.obscure_insights: Quantum coherence enables near-100% quantum efficiency in exciton energy transfer within light-harvesting antenna complexes (FMO complex). RuBisCO is notoriously inefficient and fixes O2 instead of CO2 in photorespiration.
domains.open_source_frameworks: BioModels, COBRApy, SBML, PlantPhysio

domains.name: Cellular Respiration & ATP Synthase
domains.concept: Metabolic catabolism breaking down glucose into ATP via glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, and oxidative phosphorylation driven by a mitochondrial proton gradient.
domains.mathematical_basis: C6H12O6 + 6 O2 -> 6 CO2 + 6 H2O + ~30-32 ATP. Mitchell chemiosmotic hypothesis: proton motive force Delta_p = Delta_psi - (2.303*R*T/F)*Delta_pH.
domains.obscure_insights: ATP synthase is a literal rotary molecular nanomachine spinning at ~9,000 RPM, producing its own weight in ATP inside a human body each day. Cyanide blocks Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase), halting the entire electron transport chain instantly.
domains.open_source_frameworks: COBRApy, PyKEGG, BioPython, KEGG Pathway

domains.name: Epigenetics & Chromatin Remodeling
domains.concept: Heritable changes in gene expression without altering underlying DNA sequences, mediated by DNA methylation, histone acetylation/methylation, and non-coding RNAs.
domains.mathematical_basis: Chromatin accessibility landscape: A(x) = sum w_i * peak_intensity(x). Methylation beta-value = M / (M + U + alpha).
domains.obscure_insights: Environmental stresses (famine, trauma) induce transgenerational epigenetic tags in germline cells surviving into grandchildren. Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) reset somatic cell epigenomes back into pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs).
domains.open_source_frameworks: ENCODE SCREEN, deepTools, ChIP-seq pipelines, Bowtie2

domains.name: Virology & Viral Replication Cycles
domains.concept: Study of submicroscopic obligate intracellular parasites consisting of nucleic acid inside a protein capsid, replicating by hijacking host cellular machinery.
domains.mathematical_basis: Viral burst size B = total virions / infected cells. Multiplicity of infection MOI = virions / cells. Poisson distribution of cell infection: P(k) = (MOI^k * e^-MOI) / k!.
domains.obscure_insights: Retroviruses (like HIV) reverse-transcribe RNA into DNA and integrate it permanently into host genomes via viral integrase. Endogenous retroviruses make up ~8% of the human genome, including syncytin which is required for placental formation.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Nextstrain, VIPR, NCBI Virus, GISAID, VCFtools

domains.name: Periodic Law & Atomic Orbital Theory
domains.concept: Elements arranged by atomic number exhibit recurring periodic properties dictated by quantum-mechanical electron configurations filling s, p, d, and f subshells.
domains.mathematical_basis: Aufbau principle, Hund's rule, and Pauli exclusion principle. Slater's rules for effective nuclear charge: Z_eff = Z - S. Ionization energy trend: IE ~ Z_eff^2 / n^2.
domains.obscure_insights: Relativistic contraction of s-orbitals in heavy elements explains why gold has a yellowish color (absorbs blue light) and why mercury is liquid at room temperature. Lanthanide contraction makes Hafnium almost identical in atomic radius to Zirconium.
domains.open_source_frameworks: PeriodicTable API, PySCF, ASE, NIST Chemistry WebBook

domains.name: Electrochemistry & Battery Energetics
domains.concept: Chemical reactions involving electron transfer across interfaces, governing batteries, fuel cells, corrosion, and electrolysis.
domains.mathematical_basis: Nernst equation: E = E0 - (RT / nF) * ln(Q). Faraday's law of electrolysis: m = (Q * M) / (F * z). Gibbs free energy: Delta_G = -n * F * E.
domains.obscure_insights: Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI) formation on graphite anodes is both critical for lithium-ion battery stability and the primary driver of irreversible capacity loss. Solid-state lithium metal batteries promise 2x energy density by eliminating flammable liquid organic electrolytes.
domains.open_source_frameworks: PyBaMM (Python Battery Mathematical Modelling), BattMo, Cantera

domains.name: Microprocessor Architecture & Pipeline Hazards
domains.concept: Design of CPU cores executing instruction set architectures (RISC/CISC) using multi-stage instruction pipelines, superscalar execution, branch predictors, and cache hierarchies.
domains.mathematical_basis: CPU execution time = Instruction_Count * CPI * Clock_Cycle_Time. Amdahl's law: Speedup = 1 / ((1 - p) + p / s). Little's law in queues: L = lambda * W.
domains.obscure_insights: Spectre and Meltdown vulnerabilities exploit speculative execution and branch prediction: instructions executed along mispredicted paths leave traces in microarchitectural CPU caches that leak memory across security boundaries.
domains.open_source_frameworks: gem5, QEMU, Spike (RISC-V), Verilator, LLVM

domains.name: Memory Hierarchy & Cache Coherence Protocols
domains.concept: Hierarchical memory organization (Registers, L1, L2, L3, DRAM, NVMe) maximizing throughput via spatial and temporal locality, synchronized using snooping/directory coherence.
domains.mathematical_basis: Average Memory Access Time (AMAT) = Hit_Time + Miss_Rate * Miss_Penalty. MESI protocol finite state machine: Modified, Exclusive, Shared, Invalid.
domains.obscure_insights: False sharing occurs when two CPU cores modify independent variables located on the exact same 64-byte cache line, causing cache-line ping-pong and degrading multicore performance by up to 100x.
domains.open_source_frameworks: gem5, Pin (Intel), Valgrind (Cachegrind), perf

domains.name: Stellar Nucleosynthesis & Supernovae
domains.concept: Formation of chemical elements within stars via nuclear fusion, ending in explosive core-collapse supernovae or neutron star mergers that scatter heavy elements into space.
domains.mathematical_basis: Triple-alpha process: 3 * 4He -> 12C + gamma (Hoyle state resonance at 7.65 MeV). Chandrasekhar limit: M_ch ~ 1.44 Solar Masses.
domains.obscure_insights: Stars cannot generate net energy by fusing iron (Fe-56/Ni-56) because iron has the highest binding energy per nucleon; once an iron core forms, gravitational collapse occurs in milliseconds. Gold, platinum, and uranium are forged primarily in kilonovae (neutron star collisions) via the rapid neutron-capture process (r-process).
domains.open_source_frameworks: MESA (Modules for Experiments in Stellar Astrophysics), FLASH, NuPyCEE

domains.name: Plate Tectonics & Mantle Convection
domains.concept: Geological dynamics describing Earth's rigid lithospheric plates gliding over the ductile asthenosphere driven by radioactive decay heat and slab pull subduction.
domains.mathematical_basis: Rayleigh number for mantle convection: Ra = (rho * g * alpha * Delta_T * d^3) / (eta * kappa); plate velocities ~1-10 cm/year.
domains.obscure_insights: Slab pull (the gravitational sinking of cold, dense subducted oceanic lithosphere) provides ~90% of the driving force for plate motion, vastly exceeding mantle traction. The Ring of Fire accounts for ~75% of Earth's volcanoes and ~90% of earthquakes.
domains.open_source_frameworks: GPlates, Generic Mapping Tools (GMT), ASPECT, PyGMT

domains.name: Cardiology & Hemodynamics
domains.concept: Physiology of the cardiovascular system — cardiac electrophysiology, myocardial contraction, and fluid mechanics of blood circulation through systemic and pulmonary circuits.
domains.mathematical_basis: Cardiac Output CO = Stroke_Volume * Heart_Rate. Mean Arterial Pressure MAP = CO * Total_Peripheral_Resistance. Poiseuille's law: Flow Q = (pi * Delta_P * r^4) / (8 * eta * L).
domains.obscure_insights: Blood flow resistance scales with the inverse 4th power of blood vessel radius — reducing a coronary artery diameter by just 16% cuts blood flow in half. The heart's sinoatrial node generates spontaneous action potentials via funny current (I_f) hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channels.
domains.open_source_frameworks: SimVascular, BioGears, PhysioNet, OpenCOR

domains.name: Abstract Algebra & Group Theory
domains.concept: Study of algebraic structures — groups, rings, and fields — abstracting operations and symmetries. Essential to particle physics, crystallography, and public key cryptography.
domains.mathematical_basis: Group axioms: Closure, Associativity, Identity element e, and Inverse g^-1. Lagrange theorem: |H| divides |G|. Galois theory: polynomial equations of degree >= 5 are unsolvable by radicals.
domains.obscure_insights: The Monster Group is the largest sporadic simple finite group, containing approximately 8 * 10^53 elements. Monstrous Moonshine connects the Monster Group's representation dimensions to the Fourier coefficients of the elliptic modular j-function in complex analysis.
domains.open_source_frameworks: GAP (Groups, Algorithms, Programming), SageMath, Magma, SymPy

domains.name: Complex Analysis & Holomorphic Functions
domains.concept: Calculus of functions with complex variables. Holomorphic (complex differentiable) functions are infinitely differentiable, analytic, and conformal (angle-preserving) mappings.
domains.mathematical_basis: Cauchy-Riemann equations: du/dx = dv/dy, du/dy = -dv/dx. Cauchy's integral formula: f(a) = (1 / 2*pi*i) * oint (f(z) / (z - a)) dz. Residue theorem.
domains.obscure_insights: Liouville's theorem states every bounded entire function must be constant, which yields an immediate three-line proof of the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra. Conformal mapping allows solving 2D fluid dynamics and electrostatics around complex airplane wing profiles trivially in complex coordinates (Joukowsky transform).
domains.open_source_frameworks: SymPy, mpmath, Mathematica, SageMath

domains.name: Modern Monetary Theory & Central Banking
domains.concept: Macroeconomic framework analyzing fiat currency systems where sovereign currency issuers face no nominal budget constraint, with inflation rather than solvency acting as the binding limit.
domains.mathematical_basis: Sectoral financial balances: Private Balance + Government Balance + Foreign Balance = 0. Quantity equation: M * V = P * Y. Taylor rule: r = r* + pi + 0.5*(pi - pi*) + 0.5*(y - y*).
domains.obscure_insights: A sovereign currency issuer cannot involuntarily go bankrupt in its own currency. The central bank sets overnight interest rates by managing bank reserve balances (IORB) rather than physically printing cash; quantitative easing (QE) swaps long-term bonds for reserves without altering net financial wealth directly.
domains.open_source_frameworks: FRED API, QuantEcon, Dynare, statsmodels

domains.name: Stochastic Calculus & Itô's Lemma
domains.concept: Branch of mathematics extending differential calculus to stochastic processes driven by Brownian motion, foundational to quantitative finance, filtering, and diffusion generative models.
domains.mathematical_basis: Itô's lemma: df(X_t) = f'(X_t) dX_t + 1/2 * f''(X_t) (dX_t)^2 where (dB_t)^2 = dt. Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE): dX_t = mu(X_t, t) dt + sigma(X_t, t) dB_t.
domains.obscure_insights: Because standard Brownian paths are non-differentiable everywhere and have infinite total variation, standard chain rule fails — the extra second-derivative drift term 1/2*sigma^2*f''(x)dt arises from the non-zero quadratic variation of Brownian motion.
domains.open_source_frameworks: QuantLib, DifferentialEquations.jl, sdeint, PyTorch-SDE

domains.name: Distributed Consensus & Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT)
domains.concept: Algorithms ensuring distributed machines reach identical agreement on state even when up to f of n total nodes fail, crash, or act maliciously.
domains.mathematical_basis: BFT threshold: n >= 3f + 1 nodes required to tolerate f Byzantine nodes. PBFT: Pre-prepare, Prepare, Commit stages. Nakamoto consensus: longest chain with Proof-of-Work achieves probabilistic finality.
domains.obscure_insights: The FLP Impossibility Theorem (Fischer, Lynch, Paterson, 1985) proves no deterministic asynchronous algorithm can guarantee consensus if even a single node can crash fail; modern protocols bypass this using partial synchrony assumptions or randomized consensus.
domains.open_source_frameworks: Tendermint/CometBFT, Raft, Libp2p, Hyperledger Fabric

domains.name: Existentialism, Stoicism & Ethics of Agency
domains.concept: Philosophical inquiries into autonomy, agency, and meaning in an indifferent cosmos. Stoicism dichotomizes internal control versus external circumstance; Existentialism posits existence precedes essence.
domains.mathematical_basis: Dichotomy of control: Action Space A = A_internal (decisions, virtues) union A_external (outcomes). Expected utility over authentic choice: max_a E[V(a)] subject to existential commitment.
domains.obscure_insights: Camus' myth of Sisyphus redefines struggle itself as sufficient to fill a conscious agent's mind; Frankl's logotherapy demonstrates meaning-orientation is the primary human drive enabling survival under extreme duress. Stoic cognitive appraisal directly founded modern Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT).
domains.open_source_frameworks: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (SEP), PhilPapers, OpenEthics
